purpose: Prospective external matched-panel test of state-dimension-dependent ecological memory using Sarasota County Seagrass Monitoring fixed sites.

independence_boundary.claim: external monitoring program with separate field sampling and data management from the Tampa Bay transect panel
independence_boundary.limitation: same broad Florida Gulf Coast region; do not call this an independent climate or biogeographic regime

source.authority: Sarasota County; distributed by Florida SEACAR Data Discovery Interface

known_discontinuities_before_response_ac.2018: no county survey due to red tide conditions
known_discontinuities_before_response_ac.2024: annual field season changed from winter to growing-season sampling according to the 2024 county monitoring report

primary_panel_frozen_before_response.sampling_frame: fixed sites only; random points are excluded from the primary panel
primary_panel_frozen_before_response.reason_for_end_2023: avoid mixing the pre-2024 winter sampling regime with the 2024 growing-season protocol shift in the confirmatory primary panel
primary_panel_frozen_before_response.2018_rule: structural missing survey year; never code as ecological absence
primary_panel_frozen_before_response.2019_rule: use only explicitly observed fixed-site records; unsampled sites remain missing
primary_panel_frozen_before_response.post_2023_rule: not part of the primary confirmatory analysis; any later use requires a separately declared protocol-shift sensitivity
primary_panel_frozen_before_response.stable_unit: program-defined fixed site identifier, unchanged across years
primary_panel_frozen_before_response.forbidden_fallback: do not substitute random sites, bay segments, subsegments, or nearest-coordinate matching if a persistent fixed-site identifier cannot be established response-blind

state_pair.coarse_state_required_semantics: explicit sampled presence/absence of any seagrass at the fixed site-year
state_pair.quantitative_state_required_semantics: explicit total seagrass percent cover on a 0-100 scale at the same fixed site-year
state_pair.zero_semantics: 0% must be a valid sampled zero, distinct from missing/not surveyed
forbidden: choose a focal species after seeing response prevalence
replace total cover with species composition after response opening
change the coarse-state threshold after response opening

hypothesis.primary: Lag-1 state should improve prediction for both coarse and quantitative states, while tau=10 older history should satisfy the frozen support rule for coarse state but not quantitative condition.
hypothesis.history_operator: same exponentially weighted all-prior-state operator for both dimensions
hypothesis.tau_reason: transferred unchanged from the already-frozen Tampa binary-state result

allowed_before_response_opening: field names, coded-value domains, aliases and schema-only layer definitions
forbidden_before_schema_pass: summary statistics computed from biological response fields
map inspection colored or symbolized by biological response values
must_confirm: a field that distinguishes fixed from random sampling or an equivalent fixed-site identity list
explicit total seagrass percent cover on a 0-100 scale
0 cover means sampled no seagrass and is distinct from missing/not surveyed
response_blind_schema_gate.failure: terminal_pre_response_schema_stop; do not open response rows or rescue by changing state dimension/unit

no_rescue: Do not move to random sites if fixed-site identity is unusable.
Do not include 2024+ in the primary panel after seeing outcomes.
Do not impute 2018 or incomplete 2019 observations.
Do not select a species, cover transformation, threshold, tau, learner or loss after response access.
Do not use the same Sarasota responses for a second confirmatory contract after this v1 outcome is opened.
